messages:
alex: Quick sync - we need to stack partner announcements so H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi launches don't collide across marketplace, SI demos, and press lanes. Who can map prioritized lanes and regional constraints?

taylor: I can take marketplace capacity mapping. Will check region quotas and embargo windows. ETA EOD Thu. @nina fyi for press overlap. :eyes:

jamie: I'll draft fallback routing: if H100 capacity < target, fall back to H200 or quantized MI300 image depending on workload. Short note: B200 works for low-priority batch jobs only.

nina: Press ops: need clear non-overlap of public announce windows +/- 48h. Share any proposed demo dates and we'll flag conflicts. Also we prefer no >2 vendor announcements in same day for APAC press.

kevin: Heads up - some SI partners want exclusive demo days. We should reserve 2 hard-exclusive slots per vendor where feasible. That may force pushing marketplace GA by 3 days in some regions.

alex: Good call. Let's capture as a tiny matrix. Jamie can you post a tentative mapping? Put region, primary GPU, fallback, press-risk.

jamie: Sure, quick draft below (very rough):

```
region,primary,fallback,press-risk
us-east,h100,h200,medium
us-west,mi300,h200,low
eu-central,gaudi,mi300,high
apac-south,h100,b200,high
```

jamie: Notes: APAC thermal constraints mean H100 queues often delay by 48-72h. Flagging as high press-risk.

partner-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/announce-stacking-draft-v1 - reviewers: taylor, nina, jamie.

taylor: I found quotas: us-east can support aggressive GA (x3 concurrent images) for the month, but eu-central has a 40% cap on H100 reservation. I'll add numbers to the doc.

nina: From comms POV: propose a single global publish cadence doc and a short playbook for embargo exceptions. I'll start a PR against the doc.

kevin: Ops ask: we need a fallback runtime image tagged `redwood/fallback:mi300-quant-v1` and a canary route that switches automatically if latency > 300ms for 5m. Engineering ok with that?

alex: @jamie @taylor can you both validate fallback image and routing feasibility by EOD Fri? If not, call it out and we'll escalate.

jamie: I can validate image. Quick checklist I'll confirm:
- quantized MI300 image exists
- auto-route policy can be prototyped with current routing rules
- per-tenant override preserved

taylor: will confirm quotas and gating windows.

nina: Action items summary (I'll paste into PR):
- Taylor: update marketplace capacity per region (EOD Thu)
- Jamie: validate fallback images + routing (EOD Fri)
- Nina: PR for global publish cadence + embargo playbook (EOD Fri)
- Kevin: enumerate SI exclusives and preferred dates (tomorrow)
- Alex: coordinate exec readout once matrix final

alex: Thanks all. If anything looks like it will force a public delay >72h flag it asap so we can negotiate TA with partners. :+1:

kevin: Quick question - do we want a hard block that prevents two vendor public posts within 24h, or just a recommended warning?

nina: Recommend hard block in APAC, warning elsewhere. I'll add that to PR.

taylor: Uploaded capacity sheet to the doc. Link in PR.

jamie: Found one blocker: a vendor driver update for gaudi in eu-central needs firmware sign-off next week; if it slips we lose gaudi availability in that region for at least 5 days. Marked as "firmware-risk" in the doc.

alex: Good catch. @partner-bot, create incident-ish thread for firmware-risk tracking and ping hw-ops.

partner-bot: Created task: /tasks/39284 - "gaudi firmware sign-off tracking" assigned to hw-ops. Due: next-wed.

alex: OK - re-check in 48h. If any dates drift I'll call a quick sync. Thanks everyone.
